observations: Photo shows a PlayStation console box/console area with two DualShock-style controllers in front.
The console front/label area is not clearly readable for model/size (e.g., Pro vs Slim) from this single photo.
A power cable and what looks like an HDMI cable are visible.
A box/branding at the bottom looks like it may say 'PS4' but the exact model text is not clearly legible.
No clear photo of the console rear ports, storage size, serial/model number, or any receipt.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a clearly readable 'PS4 Pro' model identifier or model number.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo of seals, warranty stickers, internal inspection, or evidence of opening/rework.
No temperature/usage test footage or error logs shown.
No photo/video of rear ports being tested (HDMI, USB, audio, power).

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows controllers/cables, but no clear receipt photo and 'original pads' wording is not verifiable from the image.

risks.risk: Model mismatch risk (PS4 Pro vs PS4 Slim/Fat). The photo does not clearly confirm 'Pro'.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the console model label (rear/bottom) showing the exact model code (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and/or a readable 'PS4 Pro' marking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 (worst case vs Pro premium).

risks.risk: Storage size risk (1TB vs 500GB/other) affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo of the console 'Settings > Storage' screen showing total capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest common storage option for that console type.

risks.risk: Controller condition risk (drift/buttons) and whether both controllers are fully functional.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing both controllers connected and passing button checks (X/O/triangle/square) and analog movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers may need service (worst case).

risks.risk: Port/HDMI/audio/USB faults not visible in a still photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a video of rear ports in use: HDMI to TV showing boot screen + at least one USB device recognized.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues not visible without a stress test.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip of gameplay for 20–30 minutes with no shutdown and no overheating warning.

risks.risk: Receipt/UK origin claim not verifiable remotely.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the UK receipt (with date/store visible) or a matching serial/receipt reference.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model label (rear/bottom) showing the exact model code and confirming it is PS4 Pro.
Screenshot/photo of 'Settings > Storage' showing total capacity.
Short video: console boot on TV + show HDMI output and at least one USB port working.
Short video: both controllers connected; demonstrate analog movement and all buttons responding (no drift).
Clip of 20–30 minutes gameplay showing no shutdown/overheating warnings.
response.reason: From photo 0, the console model (PS4 Pro vs other PS4) and key value drivers (storage size, port test, thermal stability) are not clearly verifiable, so a worst-case price cannot be confidently selected.
